meta.title: About YogSetu — The Bridge Between You and the Right Yoga Teacher
meta.description: YogSetu helps individuals, families and organisations discover and connect with verified yoga teachers across India. An initiative by YogKulam.

hero.title: The Bridge Between You and the Right *Yoga Teacher*
hero.description: YogSetu helps individuals, families and organisations discover and connect with yoga teachers across India. Explore teacher profiles, understand their experience and expertise, and connect directly with someone who fits your needs.

image.alt: Founder of YogKulam at his desk

story.title: Why We Built *YogSetu*
story.lead: “Setu” means bridge. And that is exactly what was missing.
story.body: India has a large and growing community of yoga teachers and millions of people who want to learn yoga. Yet finding the right teacher still often depends on word of mouth, social media or a random online search.

boxes.title: For Yoga Seekers, the gap is trust
boxes.text: Who is this teacher? What have they studied? What do they teach? Are they right for my needs?

boxes.title: For Yoga Teachers, the gap is visibility
boxes.text: Many capable teachers have the knowledge and training, but struggle to reach people beyond their own network.

image.alt: YogKulam founder and students practising yoga together

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Find teachers by location, language, expertise, experience and online or offline mode.

steps.title: Compare
steps.text: Explore qualifications, experience, pricing and reviews before you decide.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Send a connection request to the teacher you prefer. Your first connection is free.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Once the teacher accepts, talk directly and decide if they are right for you.

steps.title: Create
steps.text: Build your professional profile with your qualifications, experience and expertise.

steps.title: Verify
steps.text: Our team checks your details before your profile is marked verified.

steps.title: Get Discovered
steps.text: Become visible to people actively looking for yoga guidance.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Accept the requests that suit you, set your own pricing, and teach your way.

why.title: More Clarity. More Trust. *Better Connections.*
why.disclaimer: Verification confirms checked profile information only; it does not guarantee outcomes or individual suitability.

mission.mission_text: To make finding the right yoga teacher simpler and more trustworthy, while helping trained yoga professionals become visible and grow their practice.
mission.vision_text: To build a trusted network of yoga teachers across India and, over time, create a global bridge connecting yoga seekers with yoga professionals.

values.name: Yogyata
values.text: Respect for training and professional capability.

values.name: Seva
values.text: Making good yoga guidance easier to access.

backed.title: Built on Years of Experience in *Yoga Education*
paragraphs: YogSetu is an initiative by YogKulam, India's Yoga Career Launch Platform. Since 2012, YogKulam has trained 40,000+ yoga learners and aspiring professionals across India.
That experience shapes how we build trust and transparency into YogSetu. And YogSetu is open to every qualified yoga professional, whether they trained with YogKulam or elsewhere.

founder.quote:
For years, I have seen good yoga teachers struggle to reach the people who need them, while students struggle to know whom they can trust.

Yoga is a complete vidya: science, art and dharma. It deserves to be taught with knowledge, responsibility and respect for its roots.

YogSetu is our attempt to build that bridge. Our aim is simple: help the right teacher and the right seeker find each other, while creating a stronger and more organised ecosystem for Yoga.
